assay: bulk RNA-seq, whole heart, DNBSEQ-T7 PE150, HISAT2 + featureCounts (S2.4.p1)
groups: 2x2: C (saline), E (exercise), T (B16F10), TE (B16F10 + exercise); n=3 libraries per group, each pooling hearts of two mice (FIG3 legend)
primary_estimand: Effect of low-intensity exercise training on the heart transcriptome of tumor-bearing (B16F10 cachectic) mice: TE vs T (S3.3.p1, FIG4)
planned_contrasts: T vs C (tumor effect; S3.3.p1: 2020 up, 741 genes in the heart-contraction set, stated as 'upregulated' but the named genes (Myh7b) are tumor-decreased)
TE vs T (exercise effect in tumor-bearing mice; S3.3.p1: 318 of the 741 and 1447 of the 2020 reversed by exercise)
E vs C (exercise effect in tumor-free mice; implied by FIG3 clusters and PCA, S3.2.p5; no DEG count)
paper_method: edgeR (S2.4.p1); test type and filtering not stated
paper_results: T vs C: 2020 up, 741 (heart-contraction overlap set base); TE vs T reverses 318 and 1447; named reversed genes Myh7b, Pde4d, Rnf207, Tmem65, Kcnj5 (S3.3.p1), Cacnb2 (S4.p3)
